name: retrofit
title: Retrofit
description: An energy assessor's theme drawn as the energy rating chart: certificate-white pages in black print, and beside every page seven arrow-ended bands from green A to red G, with the phone number in a black pointer at band A and each fee in a small black pointer of its own.

tokens.--font-heavy: the heavy grotesque of the certificate's headings: the site name, page titles, section headings, people's names and the letters on the rating bands
tokens.--font-text: the humanist sans of everything else: running text, the menu, service rows, fees, labels and the footer
tokens.--text-small: size of small print: fees in the service rows, the labels in the booking panel, credentials, dates, tags and the footer
tokens.--color-bg: the certificate paper — the page background
tokens.--color-text: the print: text, titles, the heavy rule along the top of the page and the rules above lists and under the masthead, the menu's current-page underline and the arrow markers of a service's inclusions
tokens.--color-muted: quieter print: service descriptions, labels in the booking panel, credentials, dates, the page counter and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: the A-band green of links, of the focus ring, and of a pointer while it is hovered or focused
tokens.--color-rule: the thin rules between service rows, hours, points, table rows and news items, and above and below the chart
tokens.--color-panel: the faint ground behind code in page text
tokens.--color-pointer: the black pointers: the one at band A that carries the phone number, and the small one holding each fee
tokens.--color-pointer-ink: the text written in a pointer
tokens.--band-a: band A of the rating chart, dark green; also the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--band-b: band B of the rating chart, green
tokens.--band-c: band C of the rating chart, yellow-green
tokens.--band-d: band D of the rating chart, yellow
tokens.--band-e: band E of the rating chart, light orange
tokens.--band-f: band F of the rating chart, orange
tokens.--band-g: band G of the rating chart, red
tokens.--band-ink: the black letters A to G on the bands
tokens.--measure: widest a column of running text gets
tokens.--aside-width: width of the booking panel with the rating chart, beside the page on a wide screen
tokens.--band-height: height of one band of the chart, and the least height of the pointer beside band A
tokens.--band-gap: gap between two bands of the chart
tokens.--band-shortest: length of band A as a share of band G; the bands between grow in equal steps
tokens.--tip: depth of the arrow point at the end of every band and pointer
tokens.--rule-heavy: weight of the heavy rule along the top of the page, above the booking panel on a phone and beside a quotation
tokens.--gutter: space kept at each side of the page on a phone
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: under a label, between tags
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside rows, between paragraphs
tokens.--space-3: gap between the parts of a block
tokens.--space-4: largest gap: between blocks, between the page and the booking panel
